01The Studio

DESIGNING WITHPURPOSE. CREATINGWITH FEELING.

An independent practice of architects, interior designers and strategists, shaping homes, workplaces and hospitality spaces around the people who use them.

02Our Story

2014

Founded in a converted garage

Architecture is more than creating buildings.

FORM & SPACE began with two friends, one drawing table and a shared belief: buildings should make people feel something.

Today we are a team of thirty working across four continents. We design homes, workplaces and hotels, always starting with how a space should feel, and only then deciding how it should look.

We combine thoughtful architecture, creative exploration and purposeful design to create environments that feel timeless yet contemporary. Our work has been recognised with nine design awards, but the reviews we value most come from the people who live and work in our buildings every day.

03Philosophy

FOUR IDEASWE NEVER BREAK

  • 01

    People First

    Every decision starts with the people who will live, work and gather in the space.

  • 02

    Purposeful Design

    Nothing is decorative by default. Each line, material and opening has a reason to exist.

  • 03

    Creative Exploration

    We prototype wildly, test bravely and keep the ideas that surprise us.

  • 04

    Timeless Thinking

    We design for decades, not seasons, with materials that age with grace.

We work at every scale, from the handle on a cabinet to the shape of a city block, with the same obsession for proportion, light and material.
